title: Quality Engineering & Automation (AI‑Driven) , Vice President
description:
About This Role

Role – Vice President AQE

APG –QA is a globally distributed team supporting Quality Engineering initiatives for Apps on the Aladdin. The Testing team employs use of industry-leading tools to support the testing activities.

Job Purpose/Background: The Vice President (VP) – Aladdin Quality Engineering (AQE) will lead quality strategy, automation, and engineering excellence across Aladdin platforms, with a strong focus on ETF, Mutual Funds, and Asset Management workflows spanning Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office.

This role is responsible for driving automation‑first, AI‑enabled quality engineering, ensuring scalable, resilient, and audit‑ready delivery for mission‑critical financial systems.

Key Responsibilities

Quality & Automation Leadership

Define and execute the AQE strategy aligned with Aladdin and firmwide technology objectives. 
Drive automation first testing across UI, API, and backend layers using modern frameworks. 
Establish best practices for test suite design, regression optimization, and release confidence. 

Test Engineering & Framework Design

Own and evolve test framework architecture, including: 
UI automation (Selenium, Playwright) 
API & backend testing (REST, batch workflows) 
Data validation and reconciliation testing 
Ensure high standards for test coverage, maintainability, performance, and reliability. 
Implement robust error reporting, failure analysis, and test result assurance mechanisms. 

AI Driven Quality Engineering

Lead adoption of AI /Agentic AI for: 
Test generation and maintenance 
Intelligent test selection and orchestration 
Automated defect triage and RCA 
Embed AI into the testing lifecycle to improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. 

Cloud & Platform Enablement

Enable QA strategies for cloud native and hybrid environments. 
Drive testing approaches for distributed systems, microservices, and event driven architectures. 
Partner with Platform, DevOps, and SRE teams to strengthen environment stability and observability. 

Financial Domain & Product Expertise

Provide strong QA leadership across: 
Front Office: Order management, trading, execution workflows 
Middle Office: Settlements, confirmations, lifecycle processing 
Back Office: Accounting, reconciliation, reporting 
Deep exposure to ETFs, Mutual Funds, Asset Management products, and investment operations. 
Ensure QA processes meet regulatory, audit, and risk requirements. 

Stakeholder & People Leadership

Act as a senior partner for Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business stakeholders. 
Translate business and regulatory requirements into clear QA strategy and execution plans. 
Lead, mentor, and grow high performing global QA teams. 
Drive strong governance, communication, and transparency across delivery programs. 
The Vice President role encompasses both leadership and individual contributor responsibilities. The incumbent is expected to actively engage in hands‑on delivery and execution of complex workstreams, in addition to managing teams and driving strategic outcomes, based on evolving business and project demands. 

Required Skills / Experience

The candidate is encouraged to possess and be able to demonstrate the following:

B.E. / B.Tech. / MCA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related subject area 
10+ years of proven experience in Software Quality Assurance in a financial services firm (e.g., Investment Banking, Asset Management), including writing manual tests (positive and negative), test automation development and execution. 
Good exposure with Testing methodologies, Test plan, Test strategy, RTM and Test estimation etc. with experience in UI testing 

Technical & Automation Skills

Strong Handson and strategic experience in: 
Test Automation (UI, API, Backend) 
Selenium and Playwright 
Backend testing and data validation 
Expertise in test framework design and test suite optimization. 
Solid understanding of cloud platforms and distributed systems. 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates. 

AI & Innovation

Experience leveraging AI Agents / Agentic AI in testing or engineering workflows. 
Strong interest in applying AI to test generation, analysis, and decision-making. 

Domain Expertise

Asset Management / Financial Services background is strongly preferred. 
Deep understanding of: 
ETFs and Mutual Funds 
Front, Middle, and Back Office investment workflows 
Familiarity with financial regulations, controls, and audit expectations. 

Leadership & Soft Skills

Proven stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 
Ability to operate at both strategic and Handson levels. 
Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on quality, resilience, and scalability. 
Experience leading large, global, cross functional teams. 

Nice to Have

Experience with Aladdin or similar investment platforms. 
Exposure performance testing, resiliency testing, and chaos engineering. 
Prior experience driving enterprise-wide QA transformation initiatives. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law
